audit_standard: Realistic boundary conditions and failure modes

P1.acknowledged_boundaries: Limited to POSIX shared memory platforms and homogeneous edge compute nodes.

P2.acknowledged_boundaries: Dependent on reliable acoustic SNR and structured classroom turn-taking dynamics.

P3.acknowledged_boundaries: Restricted to 2D skeletal topologies; severe occlusions require Kalman interpolation.

P4.acknowledged_boundaries: Requires pre-synchronized relational database timetable schema and campus GIS anchors.

P5.acknowledged_boundaries: Specific to Apple Silicon UMA and NVIDIA Jetson shared memory hierarchies.

P6.acknowledged_boundaries: Wall material attenuation and multi-path reverberation in non-rectangular corridors.

P7.acknowledged_boundaries: High RAM footprint during continuous dynamic gallery expansion (>1M vectors).

P8.acknowledged_boundaries: Storage amplification under high-frequency hash tree updates; key revocation latency.

P9.acknowledged_boundaries: Subject to PID windup during rapid consecutive occlusions.

P10.acknowledged_boundaries: Requires hardware SoC support for coherent Unified Memory Architecture.

P11.acknowledged_boundaries: Flash memory write endurance degradation during high-frequency fallback reboot cycles.

P12.acknowledged_boundaries: Degraded perception modes yield lower accuracy during persistent camera hardware failures.

P13.acknowledged_boundaries: Severe non-stationary semantic shifts require global federated synchronization.

P14.acknowledged_boundaries: High inter-cluster WAN communication latency under extreme stragglers.

P15.acknowledged_boundaries: User study conducted in simulated campus environment (N=20); subject to individual spatial perception variance.

P16.acknowledged_boundaries: Network connectivity interruptions require local offline credential caching.

P17.acknowledged_boundaries: Graph convolution latency scales with graph diameter in dense multi-building topologies.

P18.acknowledged_boundaries: State space explosion if verification bound k > 20 in complex concurrent state machines.

P19.acknowledged_boundaries: Thermal transfer coefficients depend on ambient enclosure airflow and chassis heat dissipation.

P20.acknowledged_boundaries: High initial design complexity requiring formal contract specification for each layer.

P21.acknowledged_boundaries: Verification assumes hardware MMU correctness and lack of direct physical memory probing.

P22.acknowledged_boundaries: Requires multi-view or multi-sensor correlation to resolve severe out-of-distribution blur.

P23.acknowledged_boundaries: Dynamic quantization switching induces brief GPU tensor core kernel reload latency.

P24.acknowledged_boundaries: Simultaneous catastrophic failure across all sensing modalities forces fallback to historical priors.

P25.acknowledged_boundaries: Lipschitz constant computation requires offline bounding of neural network layer Jacobians.
